result.narrative:
Boeing is operationally strained but commercially strong. The payment file shows no open overdue notifications and 0 DPD; the single historical event is a $650k invoice resolved 3 days late in June 2026, reported by one policyholder. Against that, November brought a confirmed cut of 5% of commercial airplane workers (9 Nov, severity 4) and a Reuters follow-up on 20 Nov leaving open the possibility of more layoffs (severity 4). Both trace to the same cause - a slower-than-expected production ramp - alongside an October statement that 737 Max output will not significantly increase until late 2027 (severity 2) and a new watchdog audit of FAA oversight (severity 2). The positive signals are substantial: a $745B backlog, an uncontested $20B F/A-XX Navy contract, a $12B aircraft sale and 57 jets delivered in September.

The band is set entirely by news. The trace is 0.65 x 0.0 (payment, 0 DPD) + 0.35 x 79.5 (news) = 27.8, placing the buyer in Watch with a PD of 0.1784. The adjudicator agreed with caveats and the placement is robust - discounting the 20 Nov article entirely still leaves the confirmed 9 Nov cut at a decayed 77.9, barely below the 79.55 that produced the score, so the band would not move. The caveats matter for precision, not direction: the driving article is a contingent statement scored at the same base 80.0 as the confirmed cut, it probably double-counts one underlying event by refreshing decay from 77.9 to 79.55, and no article in the file has a body beyond its headline. All positive items score 0.0 and cannot offset.

The recommendation is to MAINTAIN the TCI export line at $9,000,000 on policy TCI-EX-2026-0001 (Tamrin Exports), with no change and nothing currently owed. PD of 0.1784 sits inside the 0.25 appetite target, maximum liability does not bind, and expected loss is unchanged at $1,156,032 before and after. The adjudicator's one actionable caveat is the payment input: the review is dated 2026-06-06 with trend flagged insufficient_history, and the $9M line was last reviewed April 2026, so the 0.0 payment term reflects absent data as much as good behaviour. A refreshed payment position should be obtained before this placement is relied on further.

Healthy sits below 20.0, 7.8 points down. With payment already contributing 0.0, the only route down is news decay - the half-life is 365 days, so the layoff signals will fade slowly absent new items. Confirmation that the 5% cut is complete with no further reductions, a firmer 737 Max ramp schedule, and a refreshed payment review confirming no overdues would together support a move to Healthy.
